title: Battle of Caseros
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Caseros", at revision 1382170529, opens: "The Battle of Caseros was fought near the town of El Palomar, Argentina, on 3 February 1852, between forces of the Argentine Confederation, commanded by Juan Manuel de Rosas, and a coalition consisting of the Argentine provinces of Entre Ríos and Corrientes, the Empire of Brazil, and Uruguay." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q616931, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1852 battle of the Argentinian civil wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
